case.summary: Verdict legitimate at probability 0.03; no fraud pattern, empty episode, $0 exposure. The $100.07 online purchase sat inside the card's baseline amount and home region, with no card-testing, burst or shared-device signal despite a new device and new email domain. A customer-validation request was asked and (assumed) confirmed the charge; recommended actions are CREATE_CASE, ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD (all auto). Had the customer instead denied the purchase, R2 would have called for a recommended BLOCK_CARD (L1) and CREATE_CASE.
